verdict.rationale: Bulk import is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no import capability. Authy's docs only describe capturing 2FA QR codes, which is still per-account enrollment by hand, not bulk import from other apps. The community material covers how hard it is to export out of Authy, which is the opposite direction and says nothing about importing in.

support.subject: As a power user, I can import tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling every account by hand
